rationale: Research proposal p4c3-zw-tz-isd (new-pair, disputed, medium confidence). Not approved. Evidence: Section 6: nationals of "SADC Member States except Comoros" are not required to have a visa to enter Tanzania; the Kuala Lumpur High Commission lists Zimbabwe as not requiring a visa. Conditions: SADC member state citizens. Conflicts: The Windhoek and Kigali High Commission lists of countries not requiring a visa do not include Zimbabwe. Those lists are undated and appear older. Reviewer: Resolve with the Immigration Services Department (info@immigration.go.tz) or a dated notice before approval. No stay period is stated.

Research proposal p4c3-ng-tz-isd (new-pair, disputed, medium confidence). Not approved. Evidence: Section 7, "Countries whose nationals can obtain a visa upon arrival", names Nigeria. Conditions: Eligible for both the online visa and the visa on arrival (ordinary visa USD 50). Conflicts: Section 6 of the same document exempts Commonwealth countries (except the UK, Canada, India, Pakistan, Australia and New Zealand) from visas, and Nigeria is a Commonwealth member. None of the three High Commission no-visa lists we read includes Nigeria, which is consistent with section 7. Reviewer: Section 7 names Nigeria explicitly; section 6 is a group rule. Prefer the explicit listing only after confirming with the department.

Research proposal p4c3-gh-tz-isd (re-verification, disputed, medium confidence). Not approved. Evidence: Section 7, "Countries whose nationals can obtain a visa upon arrival", names Ghana. Conditions: Eligible for both the online visa and the visa on arrival (ordinary visa USD 50). Conflicts: Section 6 of the same document exempts Commonwealth countries, which includes Ghana, and all three High Commission lists we read name Ghana as not requiring a visa. data.ts currently publishes Ghana → Tanzania as visa-free. Existing record: visa-free (tz-hc-namibia). Reviewer: Do not change the published record until the department confirms. If confirmed, the published record should move to disputed, then be superseded.

Research proposal p4c3-gh-mz-hc-uk (new-pair, pending-verification, medium confidence). Not approved. Evidence: Ghana is listed as visa-exempt "for a 30-day stay (renewable for an additional 30 days upon justification)"; exempt nationals must apply for prior authorization at evisa.gov.mz. Conditions: Visa-exempt for tourism and business; apply for an Electronic Travel Authorisation at evisa.gov.mz before travel. Renewable for a further 30 days on justification. Reviewer: Embassy source. Confirm on the SENAMI e-visa portal (evisa.gov.mz) if it becomes readable.
